name: LFOs
description: From-scratch four-channel bank of tempo-synced LFOs phase-locked to a shared 24 PPQN transport: six waveforms, sixteen synced rate divisions, per-LFO depth/phase/CC with CV, gate, trigger and MIDI CC output, MIDI clock sync in/out, pad-LED level meters, SPI-flash settings persistence and the complete VUP self-updater.
